title: A pedestrian's approach to Bayesian methods for inverse problems
summary: In the past two decades, the Bayesian approach to inverse problems in infinite dimensional spaces has seen significant developments in theory, Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods, and in applications. The Bayesian approach in finite dimension produces posterior distributions of finite dimensional random variables. In infinite dimensions, the desired objects are random fields and their laws as measures on Hilbert or Banach spaces. There are many textbooks and tutorials available that explain Bayesian methods and MCMC in finite dimensions. To enter the field of Bayesian inverse problems in…
